chunks: And from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Allah (Glorified is His Majesty) says: 'I do not divert anything from My believing servant except that I make it good for him. So let him be pleased with My decree, and let him bear patience over My trials, and let him give thanks for My blessings - and I shall record him among the truthful ones with Me.'

key_terms.الصِّدِّيقِينَ: The truthful (a high rank of believers)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of divine decree and trials for a believer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith qudsi conveys Allah's message to the believing servant, explaining that any diversion or prevention of something is ultimately for his good. The believer is instructed to be content with divine decree, patient in trials, and grateful for blessings, with the promise of being recorded among the Siddiqun (the truthful/sincere).

en.muhajir-b-ali: 48. It has been related that Abu 'Abd Allah (a.s) said:

Allah [M.G] says: Whatever I divert and keep away from My believing servant, I make it good for him. So, let him be pleased with My decree, and let him bear patience over My trials, and let him give thanks over My blessings - and I shall record him amongst the truthful ones.
